translations.web: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
translations.bsb: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile, and it is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
translations.kjv: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
translations.asv: It is fit neither for the land nor for the dunghill: men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
